dedup: by arXiv id (version stripped), then normalized title (lowercase, non-alphanumerics removed)

forward_citations.method: Semantic Scholar GET /graph/v1/paper/arXiv:ID/citations?fields=title,year,venue,externalIds,citationCount&limit=1000 (offset paging), >= 3 s between calls, HTTP 429 -> back off 5, 10, 20 s, then give up. OpenAlex fallback: every work whose title equals the seed title (plus the OpenAlex record of the arXiv DOI 10.48550/arXiv.ID and the S2 record title), then filter=cites:W... per-page=200. Cursor paging past page 1 returned HTTP 401 'API key required for cursor paging', so page=1,2,... paging was used (anonymous). Completeness check: if the S2 list was below 80% of the largest OpenAlex cited_by_count of the same paper, the OpenAlex lists were fetched and merged (by arXiv id, DOI, normalized title).
